name: VMToolsd Suspicious Child Process
description: Detects suspicious child process creations of VMware Tools process which may indicate persistence setup
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.parent.executable:*\\vmtoolsd.exe AND ((process.executable:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\wscript.exe)) OR (process.pe.original_file_name:(Cmd.Exe OR cscript.exe OR MSHTA.EXE OR PowerShell.EXE OR pwsh.dll OR REGSVR32.EXE OR RUNDLL32.EXE OR wscript.exe)))) AND (NOT ((process.executable:*\\cmd.exe AND (process.command_line:(*\\VMware\\VMware\ Tools\\poweron\-vm\-default.bat* OR *\\VMware\\VMware\ Tools\\poweroff\-vm\-default.bat* OR *\\VMware\\VMware\ Tools\\resume\-vm\-default.bat* OR *\\VMware\\VMware\ Tools\\suspend\-vm\-default.bat*))) OR (process.executable:*\\cmd.exe AND process.command_line:"") OR (process.executable:*\\cmd.exe AND (NOT _exists_:process.command_line))))
